clue.text: Drink's needed by worker — an aid to office work?

clue.text: Husky, perhaps, actor Richard goes over line in poor poetry

clue.text: Come out as one involved in US party club that's riotous

explanation.walkthrough: 'that's riotous' turns CLUB into UBLC; 'involved in' then puts I into GOPUBLC.

clue.text: Get a place on course about extremely traditional PM

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.definitionFit: Clement Attlee was the British Labour prime minister who led the post-war government, so he is an example of a PM.

clue.text: Theatre worker capturing actor's heart, provider of delicacy?
